notes.title: Tweaks & fixes
notes.notes: [p]Since last time around, we've shipped a few fixes/improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Steam icon added next to player's name matchmaking and in-game[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for a bunch of new currencies[/p][/*][*][p]Changed misleading copy in weekly results screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue causing some users to matchmake in a non-selected game mode (e.g. Moving despite only selecting No Move)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Apart from that, we're actively looking into how we can drastically improve the free offering - more updates to follow this fall. notes.title: Game updates regarding free-to-play
notes.notes:
[b]Amateur Division[/b]
[list]
[*] Up until now, unlimited Amateur Division has only been available to Steam created accounts. We're now shipping an update so that all users, including linked accounts, can replay Amateur Divison as many times as they like! 
Note: for paying users (Steam Pass or web Yearly Unlimited/Elite/"Old Pro" subscribers), the Amateur Division is only accessible if you haven't already entered the main competition (which replaces the need for Free Amateur Division)
[*] We've fixed a bug that caused legacy "Old Pro" Yearly subscribers to not have full access to the game
[/list]

[b]TL;DR: [/b]
[list]
[*] All users can now play Solo, and unranked Team Duels, in an unlimited fashion!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/30f5f88ff0ed6d5bff0e7f40f791292cb46bb068.png[/img]

notes.title: Unlimited Yearly gets full access!
notes.notes:
All users with an [b]Unlimited Yearly[/b] subscription from the web version are now granted access to GeoGuessr Steam Edition! This includes all current as well as all future such subscribers.

GeoGuessr Steam Edition is in [b]Early Access[/b]. That is, we're still developing and learning as we go. The original intent of this edition was to reach a new audience, who may or may not have heard of GeoGuessr before but primarily has Steam as their platform of choice for gaming. As such, we didn't think too much about adapting this edition to the existing user base on browser version, but wanted to give a lower priced, condensed version of our most popular game mode Duels to all the potential new GeoGuessr pros out there.

Hence, we're humbly overwhelmed to see the huge interest and engagement from the existing user base to also be able to play on Steam! To accommodate, we've therefore decided to not limit GeoGuessr Steam Edition to Elite Yearly subscribers, but also Unlimited Yearly.

Happy exploring and stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: GeoGuessr Steam Edition is now LAUNCHED!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/fe6e07de78b1a1c71624aa7e246949b4654c2844.png[/img]

Start your [b]GeoGuessr Steam Edition [/b]([i]Early Access[/i]) journey by either creating a new account, or if you already have a GeoGuessr browser account, link it to sync your account and progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/654900c5845d26fb68fe2e5cea7482db59d445b4.png[/img]

[b]The free offering includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlimited access to Amateur Division
[*] Unlimited access to unranked Team Duels
[/list]
To unlock the [b]full Solo Duels experience[/b], you’ll need to purchase a [b]GeoGuessr Steam Pass[/b] inside the game, or be on an [b]Elite Yearly[/b] subscription.

[b]General notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Having a GeoGuessr browser subscription does not grant you full access to the GeoGuessr Steam Edition, unless you have an [b]Elite Yearly[/b] subscription. Nor does a GeoGuessr Steam Pass grant you access to the GeoGuessr browser version.
[*] GeoGuessr Steam Pass holders will be able to cross-play against GeoGuessr browser subscribers and vice versa.
[*] The game is released as [b]Early Access[/b], meaning we're continuously developing it and addressing whatever issues might arise. Bear with us!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/6cc2662d0c7a3608419c5c8bc20df4f5d3fff545.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
We're more than excited to be able to (finally!) announce an exact release date! 

GeoGuessr Steam Edition will be available in store [b]May 8![/b] Let's go!!

notes.title: Update: Release coming in May!
notes.notes:
Roughly a month ago, we announced the news that [b]GeoGuessr: Steam Edition[/b] was coming to, well, Steam! Along with the annoucement, we shared a bit of information as to what the edition was to include.

Based on your feedback, we realized that we needed to ensure a convenient way to link existing GeoGuessr browser accounts to Steam. To accommodate, the release date had to be pushed slightly, which is why we're writing this to let you know that instead of April, the game will be released in [b]May[/b]. We'll keep you posted as soon as we have set a specific release date, stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/654900c5845d26fb68fe2e5cea7482db59d445b4.png[/img]

[b]Recap[/b]:
[list]
[*] This edition focuses on Competitive Solo Duels as its main game mode
[*] The game comes with a Steam exlusive, free-to-play Amateur Division
[*] Unlimited Unranked Team Duels with Steam friends
[*] Subscribers on an Elite Yearly (browser) subscription will get full access
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/6cc2662d0c7a3608419c5c8bc20df4f5d3fff545.png[/img]

notes.title: GeoGuessr is coming to Steam, hopefully ditches its most controversial feature
notes.notes:
Climbing to fame through Twitch streamers and content creators, GeoGuessr is a browser based geography game which shows you a location and prompts you to guess where you are based on your surroundings. A Steam edition of the title has just been listed, but the big question is whether or not this new edition will require users to pay a monthly subscription to play, similar to its browser version.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: GeoGuessr Steam Edition soon in store!
notes.notes:
GeoGuessr, the game where you're dropped on the streets somewhere in the world with the task to find out where you are, is soon coming to Steam! 

Set to be launched in [b]April[/b], this edition features [b]ranked Solo Duels[/b], as well as [b]unranked Team Duels[/b].

We're just doing some final polishing, but stay tuned as good things will come to those who wait!
